messages:
Priya R.: heads up — Maple Health onboarding flagged a blocker: they need a regional allowlist + short-term throughput bump while we finish their integration tests. they said traffic will double during proof-of-concept.
Sam K.: how big of a bump? do we have tenant id + target regions? @Liam G. for infra routing?
Priya R.: customer tenant: mh-prod-82. requesting +3x concurrent requests and allowlist EU-west (Frankfurt). currently onus: 100 req/min -> target 300 req/min for next 2 weeks.
Liam G.: ok, we can do rate-limit override and add EU-west routing. question: do they need dedicated capacity or just routing to hosted nodes in eu-west?
Priya R.: they asked to stay on hosted for now. will re-evaluate for Dedicated after POC. so just routing + temporary rate increase.
Sam K.: i'll draft the change and get eng signoff. need an ACL entry for their IP range and a short TTL. Priya — can you confirm IPs?
Priya R.: confirmed IPs: 54.213.12.0/24 and 3.120.45.0/24. added to ticket. also capturing feedback: they mentioned occasional 500s on longer prompts — raising as renewal risk if not resolved.
Ava M.: noted for account — POC success tied to renewal Q3. prioritizing early wins helps. i'll coordinate an enablement session next week.
Liam G.: plan: gate change behind a canary policy. steps:
1) add IP ranges to allowlist in firewall
2) add rate-limit override for tenant mh-prod-82
3) route eu-west preference for their requests
4) monitor error rate + latency for 48h, rollback if errors spike >2x baseline
example config we will apply:
```
{
  "tenant": "mh-prod-82",
  "overrides": {
    "rate_limit_per_min": "300",
    "region_preference": "eu-west",
    "allowlist_ips": ["54.213.12.0/24", "3.120.45.0/24"],
    "ttl": "14d"
  }
}
```
Liam G.: tagging @deploy-bot for audit and @eng-runtime for observation hooks.
deploy-bot: Audit entry created: audit_id=aud_2026_00087, change=rate_limit_override, tenant=mh-prod-82, user=Liam G., ts=1763601500
Sam K.: thanks. i'm scheduling the canary for 10:30 UTC today. will ping when live. :thumbsup:
Priya R.: awesome — i'll update the customer and log the feedback in Gainsight. keeping this thread for post-canary notes.
Ava M.: added renewal flag to account dashboard and scheduled a 30-min enablement call for next Tue.
Liam G.: canary started 1763602200. initial metrics look fine (throughput up, error rate stable). will keep watch and post summary after 24h.
Priya R.: thanks all — this should help onboarding velocity and reduce renewal risk. collecting any customer quotes and will share in the CRM.
